title: Causally prior source-state nonidentifiability
claim: Across the frozen later-context domain, identical causal prefixes force identical source states while later contexts produce separated intervention responses; therefore the full response is not a function of the bare source state alone.
scope: Phase1248/1249 frozen synthetic binding task and the source event causally prior to the later codebook; this does not rule out a sufficient post-context single state.
authorizes: use explicit later context or downstream response observations
reject source-only universal sufficiency
forbids: claim every single-point observation is impossible

title: Strong but unconfirmed multi-event response camera
claim: A frozen five-event trajectory camera raised code response cosine from below 0.1 to 0.8976-0.9810 across four networks, but only two of four passed the complete preregistered conjunction.
scope: Four free four-layer TinyCausalTransformers, two widths and four new seeds, synthetic cyclic codebook task.
authorizes: retain a downstream trajectory-imaging candidate
run a separately contracted equal-budget observation competition

title: Distributed observational necessity rejected by final answer state
claim: In all six 4/6/8-layer known-truth networks, the independently selected final answer-boundary state achieved code cosine 0.9976-0.9991 and strictly outperformed the equal-budget five-event camera under group bootstrap.
scope: Synthetic cyclic codebook, six free networks, equal 80-dimensional linear cameras; observational sufficiency only.
authorizes: record output-adjacent response-state sufficiency
separate ex-ante prediction from post-intervention diagnosis
forbids: infer physical necessity from camera deletion

scope: Known-truth Transformer-shaped supernetwork only; no free training, pretrained model or natural language.
authorizes: one free-network typed-edge external-validity contract
use complete cut families rather than singleton hotspots
forbids: claim planted recovery implies free-network recovery

forbids: call numerical executor mismatch a mechanism failure

claim: Across 384 CUDA FP16 tensor trials, q/ov head replacement matched an independent reference exactly with zero no-op, untouched, commutation and union error; the 32-query/8-KV GQA map was exact, and all 336 shared-base categorical triples had wrong-donor cosine one half.

title: Direct queried-value transport separates from orthogonal context transport
claim: A frozen 11-OV-head plus one-MLP late coalition achieved correct cosine 0.990863, direct correct ratio 0.993697, direct wrong ratio -0.994700, conditional cosine 0.990709 and block remaining 0.137884 on held-out templates. Null target-parallel fraction was only 0.005342, but target-orthogonal and total fractions were 0.268086 and 0.268140, so the complete content-specific gate failed.

title: Selective-operator type and path-mediation camera calibrated
claim: Across 384 known-truth systems and 1600 factorial cases per system, the frozen camera exactly distinguished global, public-control-conditioned and abstaining response geometries. Every applicable held-out target, context, wrong, null, path, manifold and control gate passed; independent audit passed 15/15.

authorizes: one free-trained cross-depth external-validity contract

No confirmation intervention or path-mediation test was authorized; independent audit passed 14/14.

authorizes: record target/null response-space collision as a camera boundary

title: Generative family identity is not the same estimand as the minimal sufficient response compiler
claim: Across 336 preregistered known-truth systems and 322,560 factorial cases, compiler type recovery was 331/336 and abstention was 48/48. Applicable A1, B, J, identity, nuisance, handoff, block and control diagnostics passed, but five smooth-local generators were already sufficient under earlier linear or quadratic candidates and two selected systems failed the manifold-tail gate. A later audit established that the correct-rescue submetric was an algebraic subtract/add replay and carries zero independent mediation evidence. The exact camera failed while exposing a generator-label versus predictive-type identifiability boundary; independent audit passed 17/17.
scope: Seven constructed conditional response families on CUDA float64, two registry splits, four tasks and six replicates; no free network, pretrained model or natural language.
authorizes: define future types by cross-fitted predictive equivalence and complexity order
retain factorial A/B/J and typed abstention as calibrated subcomponents
forbids: repair the smooth family or thresholds
equate sufficient prediction with generator recovery
run a free Transformer or Qwen3

title: Predictive functional quotient is recoverable away from a finite-sample abstention boundary
claim: Across 320 preregistered known-truth systems and 1,556,480 cases, the frozen camera recovered 318/320 reference-risk functional classes and abstained on 82/84 ambiguous or out-of-library systems. Two equivalence-overlap systems straddled the 0.050 reference boundary but fell below it on selection. All applicable factorial confirmation, independently sourced donor rescue, wrong-identity, negative-control and algebraic-replay-sentinel gates passed; independent audit passed 16/16. The full camera failed and free-network execution was denied.
scope: Eight constructed source families on CUDA float64, four nested predictive classes plus abstention, two registry splits, four tasks and five replicates; no free network, pretrained model or natural language.
authorizes: retain predictive functional equivalence as the estimand
retain independent donor rescue as a calibrated known-truth subobject
design a fresh finite-sample boundary certificate
forbids: run a free Transformer or Qwen3
